reason: An independent licensed surveyor, jointly appointed, certifies area as final and binding. An agreed method of fixing a fact; courts not expressly excluded, and cl. 13 arbitration remains. Refer (BP-7).
Limits how the premises may be used during the term. The Lessee is free to run a retail or training business elsewhere.
The Lessor's certificate is binding 'without prejudice ... to the right of the Lessee to dispute the computation in accordance with Clause 13'. The arbitration forum is kept.
During the term only, but restrains the Lessee from taking any other office on M.G. Road or within 1 km for its software business. In-term restraint on business elsewhere. Refer.

The Lessor's own assessment of damage is final and, notwithstanding cl. 13, cannot be questioned 'in any arbitration, suit or other proceeding whatsoever'. No forum for that class of claims. Void to that extent.
Two years after handover, Raheja Towers and M.G. Road. Post-lease restraint; the renewal at a stated rent is consideration, not goodwill. Void.
A written agreement to refer a difference that has already arisen (the 2003-05 charges) to arbitration by a jointly nominated chartered accountant. Saved by Exception 2.
Binding arbitration by a mutually appointed sole arbitrator under the 1996 Act, with Bangalore courts (where the premises are) for injunctions. Valid.

Area is certified by the building's architect nominated by the Lessor, and 'no suit, arbitration or other proceeding shall lie ... in any court or before any tribunal'. A party's nominee plus an express exclusion of every forum. Void to that extent.
Goodwill of the coffee kiosk is sold and the restraint lasts while the buyer carries on, but it applies 'anywhere whatsoever'. No specified local limits, so outside Exception 1. Void.
No suit, arbitration or proceeding over suspension of facilities, 'howsoever caused', and no court or tribunal may entertain the claim. Absolute bar for that class of claims; void to that extent.
'Restricted Period' (Section 3(f)) is 12 months from the Expiration Date or earlier termination, in the Restricted Area. Post-lease restraint; no goodwill. Void.
The Lessor's covenant not to let to competitors runs during the term and for 2 years after the Expiration Date. In-term part valid; the post-term part is the doubtful one. Refer.

Notwithstanding GTC-42, the Lessor's Certificate (GTC-11(d)) is final and cannot be questioned before the arbitral panel, any court or any authority. No forum for that class of disputes. Void to that extent.

Courts at Pune alone, for premises in Madhapur, Hyderabad, with arbitration at Hyderabad. Pune may have jurisdiction over money claims (the Lessee's address is there), but not over the property. Refer.

A CPWD Executive Engineer, nominated by CPWD rather than by either party, decides whether a repair is major and its reasonable cost, 'final and binding'. A technical question for an independent expert; courts not expressly excluded. Refer (BP-7).
The Lessor will not let other parts of the building to a competing business during the lease. Restriction on dealing with property, in-term only.
A binding arbitration agreement under the 1996 Act. Appointment of the sole arbitrator by POWERGRID's CMD is bad under TRF, Perkins Eastman and CORE, but that goes to appointment, not s.28.
The courts where the premises are situated. Those courts have jurisdiction over the property anyway.

The Lessor's claims for rent, damages and possession go to the Lessee's own Regional Grievance Committee, whose decision is final, and the Lessor may not arbitrate or sue. One party judges its own cause and every forum is shut. Void to that extent.
